subject: banshee-haven
label: Banshee Haven is built downward, and you come in on the right
from: A name, twelve women, ten unlocated bathrooms and no rooms at all. Entrance recorded on the LEFT titty
to: SIXTEEN ROOMS, TWO SURFACE STRUCTURES, AND A WHOLE BODY UNDERGROUND. Entrance is the RIGHT
note:
MARIBEL WROTE THE APPENDIX HERSELF AND IT IS THE THIRD HOUSE'S FIRST REAL FLOOR PLAN.

THE CORRECTION FIRST: the Archive had the only door on the LEFT titty. It is the RIGHT — the VICTORIAN COTTAGE, Elspeth's kitchen and Chapel, warm timber and climbing ivy and the smell of bread. THE CATHEDRAL IS THE LEFT, with Bell's Séance Parlor at its apex, at the nipple, THE MOST EXPOSED AND VULNERABLE POINT OF THE HOUSE'S SURFACE.

THE ARCHITECTURE IS THE THESIS. Two rounded structures emerge from the forest floor and everything else — the midriff, the shoulders, the ribs — IS BENEATH THE SOIL. You walk into what looks like a cosy Victorian house and find a staircase, and it goes DOWN, and the house opens beneath you into something vast and candlelit and resonant.

BREASTS DO NOT FLOAT. THEY SIT ON A BODY.

Ghost Haven was built UPWARD from devotion. Specter Haven SIDEWAYS from chaos. THIS HOUSE WAS BUILT DOWNWARD FROM GRIEF, and the land gave the house of catharsis the architecture of BURIAL AND RESURRECTION.

THE APPENDIX IS v0 AND PREDATES THE HOUSE FILLING. It records twelve couple rooms with three claimed — Bell and Elspeth, Alexis and Lyric, Magnolia and Daisey — and a capacity of twenty-four. The Archive carries twelve residents in six couples across Arcs 13 and 14. Viraena is bringing an updated appendix and that discrepancy resolves then, not now.
